{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
num_responded = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_df)
response_fraction = num_responded / total_treatment

print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {total_treatment}")
print(f"Number who responded: {num_responded}")
print(f"Response fraction: {response_fraction}")"}
